quest.title: The Unexpected Guest
quest.description: Concerned about the situation down in The Chasm, you and Paimon decide to go investigate the area, only to run into someone altogether unexpected there...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x22000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the lower levels of The Chasm
Go to the lower levels of The Chasm

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Oh? {NICKNAME} and Paimon? I didn't expect to see you two here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei? Shouldn't you be at work in Liyue Harbor? What are you doing out in the middle of nowhere?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, to be perfectly honest, this case is a little out of the ordinary... In fact, this is the first time I've ever witnessed the bottom of The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, but before I forget! Could you do me a favor, please? If anyone happens to ask about me or my present whereabouts, just tell them you haven't seen me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: No, no, it's not like that. Look, it's quite a long story.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: So if you could, please just cover for me. I'll see you later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! And there she goes... Huh, what in Teyvat was that all about? Paimon's starting to feel nervous all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you think she did something illegal and now she's gone into hiding here? *gasp* Or maybe something super scary happened...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Doubt it, Yanfei is a legal adviser, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be so naive! The world is complicated these days, you know. We should be prepared for the worst, if something really did happen, we might find ourselves becoming her accomplices!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, what a dilemma... Should we really cover for her...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, you are the one that's both naive and complicated...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey! You over there! Yeah, you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhh! Someone's coming!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that voice sounds pretty familiar...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha, it's you two. So uh, what are you two doing in a place like this, huh? Wait, don't tell me... you're on vacation!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's the one and oni Itto.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I must say, you two are lookin' pretty good, things been going your way lately? 'Cause I have been doing amazing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Itto, who's that behind you?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Hey there, I'm with the Arataki Gang, Kuki Shinobu. Nice to meet you!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahahaha, right, I almost forgot she was back there. Let me introduce you to Shinobu, the pride and joy of the Arataki Gang!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Another member of Itto's gang!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Lemme tell ya, she's one of Hanamizaka's best and brightest, so of course she's in the gang. Shinobu takes care of practically everything in the Arataki Gang. She can protect you guys, too, you know.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: #A friend of the boss is a friend of mine. You must be {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep yep! Nice to meet you too, Shinobu!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nice to meet you, Shinobu.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: The pleasure is mine. I have a feeling that we'll be working together soon enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, uh, Itto, if she's the one that takes care of everything in the gang, then doesn't that kinda make her the gang's real boss?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Pff, are you kidding!? Of course I'm the boss. To the four corners of Teyvat, there is only one boss of Hanamizaka's legendary Arataki Gang. Me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, okay Paimon gets the dynamic now. A useless boss with an ultra-capable subordinate...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, you...! Ugh, you know what, forget it. The average person couldn't possibly understand the dynamics of the Arataki Gang. As the leader, I can't let myself stoop down to your level.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anywayyy, have you seen a pink-haired legal... uh, mage lady? Wears a goofy hat, knows everything, kinda short.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Her name's Yanfei, she's a legal adviser from Liyue. I thought perhaps you two would know her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, no... we haven't seen her! We don't know this person at all! Hehe...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Aha! So you have seen her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, no, what gave you that idea!? Paimon didn't say anything!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Aww, look at you getting all antsy. Ha! Seems I was able to get to the truth after all.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: When someone is lying, their eyes often start wandering subconsciously.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Anyway, don't worry. I assure you we don't have any ill intentions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So uh, you guys know Yanfei?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, she uh, kinda saved my life. So yeah, you could say we've met.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's saved your life? Wait, hold on, what are you two doing in The Chasm anyway?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry, Paimon can be a bit slow...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You know that the Sakoku Decree has been lifted recently in Inazuma, right?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, Shinobu wanted to come to Liyue and pick up her graduation certificate. I came along because it's safer to travel in numbers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Graduation certificate? Did you study in Liyue?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yes, I studied law at the Tongwen Academy in Liyue. Unfortunately, the Sakoku Decree was implemented just when I was home visiting my family before graduation... so I'm a few years late getting my graduation certificate.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: We were taking care of some errands in Liyue and the boss got tangled up with some Millelith while we were standing in a line... He was about to get arrested when, luckily, Yanfei happened to be walking past and helped us out.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Yep. If it wasn't for her, our trip to Liyue would've ended with me in the slammer, hehe. So, you know, I just wanted to do something nice to show my heartfelt gratitude.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But she said she didn't need my help with anything. I thought there's a chance she might run into trouble here on her own, so I followed her here... just in case she needs me to come leaping to her rescue.

choices.text: So, you're forcing her to accept your help.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What? No, it's not like that at all! Look, I just want to protect her, OK? She looked like she was in a hurry, so I thought she must be out doing something important.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: People can get into trouble when they're out in the world dealing with serious business, you know? I'm just being considerate, really.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: #Ahem, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Is Shinobu trying to hint at something?)

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: ...(that way)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Maybe she's hinting for me to distract Itto...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh, Yanfei went that way.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, great, thanks! I'll go after her. Shinobu, time to roll!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Fear not, my savior! Itto's coming to your rescue!!!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Appreciate the help. Until next time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh Traveler, did you just send Itto the wrong way on purpose? Shinobu seemed pretty sharp, Paimon doesn't think you can pull one on her like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or maybe, she knows that Itto can be a big nuisance, so she's trying to stop him from bothering Yanfei... Oh if that's the case, then wow, she really knows how to call the shots.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, at least this way, nobody will be bothering Yanfei. If we run into her again later, we should let her know that we helped her out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, now let's go take a look at the crash site from last time.

choices.text: Do Oni usually repay acts of kindness like this?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Listen, Granny said that a man must learn to be grateful, and I'm gonna help this legal adviser lady, no matter what it takes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's nice and all, but what if she really doesn't need your help?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha, you're joking right? I mean, that's not possible. Of course she needs my help.

choices.text: You let it slip the moment you said "uh-oh."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, Yanfei is here, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey Yanfei, we've sent away the people that were following you.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh, good, thanks a lot. The guy with the weird outfit seemed super outgoing. Normally, I don't mind making friends, but I've got work to do today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? So what kind of work are you doing in a place like this? Don't tell Paimon you're thinking about becoming an adventurer, too!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Well, as a legal adviser, sometimes I also have to travel in person. I came to The Chasm to deal with a will.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—A will...?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: That's right. I found a will inside an old book, I'm guessing it was left by someone of great importance. It appears he lost a magical device and wished to retrieve it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't know legal advisers have to deal with that kind of thing. What a job...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Will execution is also part of my work as a legal adviser. Of course, cases like this are quite rare. The Chasm is not the kind of place you can just waltz into whenever you want.
Oh? So, you do know what kind of place this is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! Who's that?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ah, I thought I might find you here.
Whatever case you're working on in The Chasm, I'm sure Liyue's top legal consultant can handle it without my input.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Huh, that's funny — I thought we'd established that my legal opinion doesn't count for anything when Yelan's around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, who is she?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: This is Yelan. Liyue's uh... Well, let's just say she works in the Ministry of Civil Affairs. I can at least say that much, right? Anyway, she's a friend of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Sure. Coincidentally, I have something to do here as well. Seems chance has brought us all together.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You may not know me, Traveler and Paimon, but I've certainly heard about you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh really? I guess I do have many friends in Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You're all here on business, and it's my job to monitor The Chasm. According to regulations, I should accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But as it turns out, I have other things that require my attention. I'm afraid I can't join you this time. You may go about your business, just try to not make a ruckus.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Aww, that's most unfortunate, I was about to ask for your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Could you spare a little time to help me take care of this will... for old times' sake?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmm, I dunno... depends what's in it for me...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Fair enough, I suppose even a guide needs to get paid. It just so happens that Madame Ping gave me some nice tea. I'll treat you to a cup, if you agree.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hehe, why don't you tell me a little more about how you got here first? Then I'll...
Hey! You!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Itto? What is he doing back here!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #I know what you two did... You really tried to throw me off, didn't you? Hmph, and I thought we were buds, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, they're also my friends, so...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: That's close enough.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Sorry, this area is part of The Chasm. It's closed to the general public.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Are you kidding me? I don't see any warning signs or fences, what gives you the right to keep me out?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Kid, where there's real danger, you'll never see a warning sign.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon never knew this place was so important.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It really is an unusual place...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: It's true, this is not a place you can just go in and out of as you wish. That's also why I didn't want anyone to follow me. Unfortunately, you didn't listen...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The Traveler has done a lot for Liyue in the past, and Yanfei is a renowned legal consultant in Liyue, so I can trust their intentions. As for you two...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, what's that supposed to mean!? You trying to say I'm not famous enough and my intentions are no good?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I don't know your background, so I can't give you free passage here. Besides, Yanfei doesn't seem to need your help, does she?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hah! How would you know what Yanfei needs? What, are you two joined at the hip or something?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Right... Anyway, I don't need to be a mind-reader to see that...? In any case, as a visitor from Inazuma, I'd suggest you defer to a local when in doubt. Stick to the local rules and keep yourself out of trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Argh! Why you...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Please, try not to be impulsive. She is right, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, things are starting to get a little heated here...

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Not good... He really shouldn't start butting heads with Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: It's true that we don't know anything about the unique conditions of this place, so we'll heed your advice and leave immediately. But if this really is a dangerous area, seriously, you should put up a sign.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Thanks for the suggestion, I'll consider it.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? And what if we don't leave? Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Then I'm afraid things might get... unpleasant.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Is that so? You really think you can take the two of us? Gotta admit, I like your optimism.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Although you're friends with the Traveler and Yanfei, I'd still suggest you heed my warning.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Haha... thanks for that, but too bad I'm not buyin' it! If you're so strong, then why don't you show me what you got!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Hold on, Boss. There's no need to start a fight here!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, no, I'm going in whether she likes it or not.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Heh... You think I was joking around, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, these two are about to go at it!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Please wait a minute, you two. This whole thing started because of me. Why don't you save me the embarrassment and just... huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The ground is shaking!?)

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Uh oh, it's a... Ahh!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey stop trying to change the subject! I'm gonna... huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wh—What happened? Hey, {NICKNAME}, are you alright?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Oww... putting my books under me to break the fall didn't help at all.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Ugh... This place...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Where are we...?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ugh, gonna feel that in the morning... Hey, Shinobu, Traveler... and my savior! Is everyone okay?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: *sigh* Well, this is an unfortunate turn of events.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, so uh, how far down did we fall?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: It seems the ground collapsed during our little confrontation up there. Perhaps because we triggered the elemental forces...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, don't look at me. If you weren't so rude, maybe I wouldn't have gotten mad. Who can put up with that kind of 'tude?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: It's my duty to stop intruders from breaking into important places. If telling the truth sounds rude, then I'm afraid you're just a little too fragile.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey! Life's too short to give in all the time!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Boss, I'm afraid you're not going to win this argument. I suggest we stop provoking her.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, whose side are you on here?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I'm simply pointing out the facts. I understand how you feel, but you're making my life difficult by starting random fights with everyone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, looks like Itto can't argue against either Yelan or Shinobu... He's in a real tough spot now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So Itto and Shinobu are kinda like you and me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Hey! What do you mean? Don't you dare compare Paimon to Itto!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Whoa, whoa! What do YOU mean? You lookin' for a fight too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon was just saying how it is... Everyone knows you're a bit of an idiot.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You calling me an idiot!? Oh yeah, well you're a puny little flying Lavender Melon. Hah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Flying Lavender Melon? Ohhh that's it, Paimon's mad! Time to give you an ugly nickname... Uh, Bull-Chucker! Hmph, you better mind your manners, Bull-Chucker.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: We seem to be a long way down from where we fell. It's impossible to see what's going on up above.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: It's unlikely we'll be able to climb back up that far. We'll need to find another way.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'm sorry to interrupt your lovely little chat here, but I think there's something you may need to know.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The Chasm is regarded as a mysterious area in Liyue. It was sealed off for years due to a mining accident. Whatever goes on down here, I suggest you remember this: You didn't see anything, you didn't hear anything, and you're not gonna ask any questions. Save you from getting caught up in things you shouldn't know about.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I won't treat you as hostiles, and in exchange, I hope you won't make things difficult when it comes to keeping secrets. I'll do what I can to find a way out.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Where does she think she's going?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Like she said, to search for an exit. Chances are that Yelan is the best among us at survival and handling emergencies, we should just let her go.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I'm afraid I must apologize... I don't typically disclose details of a client's will to third parties, which is why I couldn't tell you the truth... I'm sorry.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I came to The Chasm in search of the Fantastic Compass, which is mentioned in the will. Many years ago, my client gave this magical device to someone ambitious, hoping that it'd be handy in times of need.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: According to an eye-witness account, the person who received the device took it into The Chasm and has been missing ever since.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Throughout history, many wars have been fought in the vicinity of The Chasm. Even if that person died in one of the wars, I still wish to do my utmost and find the device, and fulfill the client's wish.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Yelan's words of caution were not unwarranted. There are dangers lurking in The Chasm... I'm sure you've all realized that by now. Given that we're all caught in this mess, let's try to find a way out together.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Whatever you say, my savior... I'll do whatever you ask. From now on, we're a team, all of us. And as for that big jerk... Well, hmph, I guess that includes her, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You said Yelan works for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, huh? Paimon could tell she's tougher than most, but wow, her job sounds demanding.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Well, that's what she tells outsiders... I can't disclose too much about her identity, but I'd say she's the only person who can handle this type of work.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What kind of lame job would have someone go out to the middle of nowhere?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon knows! An adventurer!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's with the face? Did Paimon say something wrong? That's literally what the two of us do, isn't it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm the adventurer, Paimon. Not you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, you're so stingy these days... Just let Paimon be an adventurer by association, okay?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #Yeah, she's got a point, {NICKNAME}, you're Paimon's boss. Take it from me, as a great leader, you should learn to be a little more generous... You know, let your sidekick share some of the glory.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, you really don't understand anything about us!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Paimon, don't take him too seriously. He's just joking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, for the sake of Shinobu... Fine.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hmph, I'm the boss, so I'll let it slide.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Perhaps this was another sealed location, but an undocumented one... What could be in here?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I've got some food and water on me. If anyone needs some, just let me know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! You know, Bull-Chucker, you may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but your subordinate here seems super capable and reliable!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hehe, I know, isn't she the best... Hey! I am too a sharp tool!

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: There seems to be an entrance up ahead with a path inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wonder where it leads to... Well, let's go take a look.

choices.text: Did we fall... into this place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who woulda guessed we'd find a Domain entrance in a place like this...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If there's a way in, then there's a way out. Let's go and take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: The rocks here seem to be old Liyue Mountain Rocks, they're similar to what I've seen in books. This domain must have existed for quite some time now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: (What's that sound?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Oh, it's Xiao!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Conqueror of Demons? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Oh, I came down from above. I heard a noise, so I followed it here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're not here by accident. Wanna team up?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: No, I have something else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it something important?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I'm looking for someone.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You shouldn't be here. I would urge you to go back as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's Xiao for ya... Shows up without warning and disappears without a trace.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Heh, that guy looked pretty tough, maybe almost as tough as me. Seems like a solid dude.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously, Bull-Chucker, where do you get your confidence from...?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Should we really be letting him go off on his own?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, he wouldn't listen, no matter how much you tried to talk him out of it... He is super tough, though, so don't worry about him.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Everyone, keep your eyes and ears peeled from here on out. We don't know what lies ahead, so we have to be ready for anything.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, look, I'm happy to say we're all on the same team and everything, but... could you cut the little speeches and the whole follow-the-leader act? I, for one, think I should be able to look after myself...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ugh, okay, okayyy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Besides, Yelan is just looking out for everyone. You know, Bull-Chucker, you're a guest here, so maybe try to get along with everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hah! Please! You're not a local either, Flying Lavender Melon, so stop trying to sound like one!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... Well, this place is just as creepy as Paimon remembers it. If it wasn't for our little investigation, Paimon wouldn't ever come anywhere near this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hey look, there's someone over there!
